description: Use before you pick or call an agent or tool you have not used: give its endpoint URL, registry name or agent id. Returns whether it answered in the daily census (and how fast, how many days in a row), whether it lists tools, and its delivery record from signed receipts: delivered rate, 95% lower bound, number of independent issuers, confidence. Free; no paid placement.

target.description: Endpoint URL, registry name (e.g. ai.llpro.countersign/countersign) or agent id

name: agentrecord_lookup
